text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *pant*... haa...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ha... haha...
What the heck... I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I think through everything... I can win!
There was no need to be that anxious—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh.
This feeling—)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Lose, learn from it, and overcome it.
That means I'm guaranteed to get even stronger now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even when I pull away, she slowly closes the gap.
Next time, maybe...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Sky-san.
...It hurts to admit, but that was a wonderful run.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still! Next is my turn.
You'd better show up to the Tenno Sho (Autumn), too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Having overcome today to become truly top-tier,
this King shall be your opponent!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, say something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Why aren't you running your mouth like usual, saying,
'Oh, there goes King saying silly things again~'?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Boring.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Everything has just...
become so boring.
Seiun Sky blurted something out, instantly freezing the air in the room.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't mean anything.
...Let's go back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hmm, hmm-hmm~.

Seiun Sky acted aloof as usual.
However, I couldn't simply overlook what she had just said.
choice_data_list: What do you mean, it got boring?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Not you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I only muttered a little something under my breath,
and both of you are taking it way too seriously~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Even Sei-chan says pointless things sometimes!
Don't get so worked up over it☆"
choice_data_list: ...Well then, let's move on to the next topic.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, the race King suggested
sounds fine to me~.
Having proven herself in the Tenno Sho (Spring), she'll now want to show off that same strength this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, something like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Running only in major races...
Sei-chan really is amazing.

Seiun Sky mutters as if it's someone else's problem.
Her eyes seem to be looking off into the distant horizon...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, Sei-chan has a stop to make.
Go ahead and head back to the academy first.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...The training camp is coming up soon,
so Trainer, please go ahead with the preparations.

"...It seems she won't let me probe any further.
Though worry lingered, remembering the fighting spirit she showed at last year's summer camp... I decided to trust her."
